text: This report recommends approval of five grants with a combined value of $848,077.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the grant requests summarized in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 7, 2025) from the Senior Grants Manager, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, which includes grants recommended for approval and project descriptions. 2. Declined the grant requests summarized in Confidential Attachment 2 to the report (November 7, 2025) from the Senior Grants Manager, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, and received the rationale for partial funding decisions, including original requested amounts. 3. Authorized the public release of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 7, 2025) from the Senior Grants Manager, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, only for grants approved by the Board, and direct that confidential information on any declined grants remain confidential, as it contains financial information, supplied in confidence to The…
